cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Extensor retinaculum
cards.label: I

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Attaches laterally to distal radius and medially to styloid process of ulna, triquetrum and pisiform region.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Holds extensor tendons close to the wrist and prevents bowstringing during extension.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Contents
cards.answer: Forms six dorsal osteofibrous compartments for the extensor tendons at the wrist.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Tenosynovitis may occur in specific compartments, such as de Quervain tenosynovitis in the first dorsal compartment.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Head of the ulna
cards.label: II

cards.question: Bone
cards.answer: Distal ulna.
cards.label: II

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with the ulnar notch of the radius at the distal radioulnar joint.
cards.label: II

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Separated from the carpal bones by the triangular fibrocartilage complex.
cards.label: II

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Radius
cards.label: III

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates distally with scaphoid and lunate and with ulna at the distal radioulnar joint.
cards.label: III

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Radial styloid, dorsal tubercle and ulnar notch are key distal landmarks.
cards.label: III

cards.question: Orientation
cards.answer: Radial styloid lies laterally; dorsal tubercle lies posteriorly.
cards.label: III

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pisiform bone
cards.label: IV

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with the triquetrum.
cards.label: IV

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Flexor carpi ulnaris inserts here; gives attachment to pisohamate and pisometacarpal ligaments and abductor digiti minimi.
cards.label: IV

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Sesamoid bone within the flexor carpi ulnaris tendon on the palmar ulnar side of the wrist.
cards.label: IV

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Extensor digitorum muscle
cards.label: a

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Extends digits 2–5 mainly at metacarpophalangeal joints and assists wrist extension.
cards.label: a

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Posterior interosseous nerve, continuation of deep radial nerve (C7–C8).
cards.label: a

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Lateral epicondyle of humerus via common extensor tendon.
cards.label: a

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Extensor expansions of digits 2–5.
cards.label: a

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tendon of the extensor digitorum muscle
cards.label: b

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes beneath the extensor retinaculum in the fourth dorsal compartment and continues onto digits 2–5.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Extensor expansions of digits 2–5, ultimately reaching middle and distal phalanges through central and lateral bands.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Transmits extensor digitorum force to extend the fingers.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Connected to adjacent extensor tendons by juncturae tendinum on the dorsum of the hand.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Extensor pollicis longus muscle
cards.label: c

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Extends the thumb at interphalangeal and metacarpophalangeal joints; assists extension at carpometacarpal joint.
cards.label: c

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Posterior interosseous nerve (C7–C8).
cards.label: c

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Posterior middle ulna and interosseous membrane.
cards.label: c

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Base of distal phalanx of thumb.
cards.label: c

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Extensor pollicis brevis muscle
cards.label: d

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Extends thumb mainly at metacarpophalangeal and carpometacarpal joints.
cards.label: d

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Posterior interosseous nerve (C7–C8).
cards.label: d

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Posterior radius and interosseous membrane.
cards.label: d

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Base of proximal phalanx of thumb.
cards.label: d

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Abductor pollicis longus muscle
cards.label: e

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Abducts and extends thumb at carpometacarpal joint; assists radial deviation of wrist.
cards.label: e

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Posterior interosseous nerve (C7–C8).
cards.label: e

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Posterior ulna, radius and interosseous membrane.
cards.label: e

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Base of 1st metacarpal.
cards.label: e

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Extensor digiti minimi muscle
cards.label: f

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Extends the 5th digit and assists wrist extension.
cards.label: f

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Posterior interosseous nerve (C7–C8).
cards.label: f

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Lateral epicondyle via common extensor tendon.
cards.label: f

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Extensor expansion of 5th digit.
cards.label: f

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Flexor carpi ulnaris muscle
cards.label: g

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Flexes and adducts (ulnar deviates) the wrist.
cards.label: g

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Ulnar nerve (C8–T1).
cards.label: g

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Medial epicondyle, olecranon and posterior border of ulna.
cards.label: g

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Pisiform, with continuation via pisohamate and pisometacarpal ligaments to hook of hamate and base of 5th metacarpal.
cards.label: g

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Extensor carpi radialis longus muscle
cards.label: h

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Extends and abducts (radially deviates) the wrist.
cards.label: h

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Radial nerve (C6–C7).
cards.label: h

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Lateral supracondylar ridge of humerus.
cards.label: h

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Base of 2nd metacarpal.
cards.label: h

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Extensor carpi radialis brevis muscle
cards.label: i

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Extends and abducts the wrist.
cards.label: i

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Deep branch of radial nerve (C7–C8).
cards.label: i

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Lateral epicondyle via common extensor tendon.
cards.label: i

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Base of 3rd metacarpal.
cards.label: i

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Dorsal interosseous muscles of the hand
cards.label: k

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Abduct digits 2–4 from the axis of the middle finger; assist MCP flexion and IP extension.
cards.label: k

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Deep branch of ulnar nerve (C8–T1).
cards.label: k

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Adjacent sides of metacarpals.
cards.label: k

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Bases of proximal phalanges and extensor expansions of digits 2–4.
cards.label: k

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Adductor pollicis muscle
cards.label: l

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Adducts thumb and assists power grip.
cards.label: l

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Deep branch of ulnar nerve (C8–T1).
cards.label: l

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Oblique head: bases of metacarpals 2–3 and capitate; transverse head: shaft of 3rd metacarpal.
cards.label: l

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Medial base of proximal phalanx of thumb.
cards.label: l

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Abductor digiti minimi muscle
cards.label: m

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Abducts the 5th digit and assists MCP flexion.
cards.label: m

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Deep branch of ulnar nerve (C8–T1).
cards.label: m

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Pisiform and tendon of flexor carpi ulnaris.
cards.label: m

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Medial base of proximal phalanx of 5th digit and extensor expansion.
cards.label: m

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Flexor digiti minimi muscle of the hand
cards.label: n

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Flexes the 5th digit at the metacarpophalangeal joint.
cards.label: n

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Deep branch of ulnar nerve (C8–T1).
cards.label: n

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Hook of hamate and flexor retinaculum.
cards.label: n

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Medial base of proximal phalanx of 5th digit.
cards.label: n

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Opponens digiti minimi muscle
cards.label: o

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Draws 5th metacarpal anteriorly and rotates it, contributing to opposition/cupping of the hand.
cards.label: o

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Deep branch of ulnar nerve (C8–T1).
cards.label: o

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Hook of hamate and flexor retinaculum.
cards.label: o

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Medial border of 5th metacarpal.
cards.label: o

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tendon of flexor pollicis longus muscle
cards.label: p

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes through the carpal tunnel and then within the fibrous digital sheath of the thumb.
cards.label: p

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Base of distal phalanx of thumb.
cards.label: p

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Flexes the thumb, especially at the interphalangeal joint.
cards.label: p

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tendon of the flexor digitorum superficialis muscle
cards.label: q

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes through carpal tunnel and digital sheaths; each tendon splits around the FDP tendon at Camper's chiasm.
cards.label: q

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Sides of middle phalanges of digits 2–5.
cards.label: q

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Flexes proximal interphalangeal joints and assists MCP/wrist flexion.
cards.label: q

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Flexor retinaculum
cards.label: r

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Attaches laterally to scaphoid tubercle and trapezium, and medially to pisiform and hook of hamate.
cards.label: r

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Forms the roof of the carpal tunnel and prevents flexor tendon bowstringing.
cards.label: r

cards.question: Contents
cards.answer: Carpal tunnel contains median nerve and nine flexor tendons: four FDS, four FDP and one FPL.
cards.label: r

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Median nerve compression beneath it causes carpal tunnel syndrome.
cards.label: r

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lumbrical muscles
cards.label: s

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Flex MCP joints and extend IP joints of digits 2–5.
cards.label: s

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: 1st–2nd lumbricals: median nerve; 3rd–4th: deep branch of ulnar nerve (C8–T1).
cards.label: s

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Tendons of flexor digitorum profundus.
cards.label: s

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Lateral sides of extensor expansions of digits 2–5.
cards.label: s

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Annular pulley
cards.label: t

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Strong transverse thickening of the fibrous digital sheath attached to the phalanges/metacarpophalangeal region.
cards.label: t

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Holds flexor tendons close to the phalanges and prevents bowstringing during finger flexion.
cards.label: t

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: A1 pulley thickening or stenosis is a common cause of trigger finger.
cards.label: t

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cruciate (cruciform) pulley
cards.label: u

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Flexible crossed fibres within the fibrous digital sheath between annular pulleys.
cards.label: u

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Retains flexor tendons while permitting the sheath to fold during finger flexion.
cards.label: u

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Flexor pollicis brevis muscle
cards.label: v

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Flexes thumb at the metacarpophalangeal joint and assists opposition.
cards.label: v

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Superficial head mainly recurrent branch of median nerve; deep head often deep branch of ulnar nerve (C8–T1).
cards.label: v

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Flexor retinaculum and trapezium, with deeper fibres from carpal region.
cards.label: v

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Lateral base of proximal phalanx of thumb via sesamoid.
cards.label: v

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Opponens pollicis muscle
cards.label: w

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Opposes thumb by flexing and medially rotating the 1st metacarpal.
cards.label: w

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Recurrent branch of median nerve (C8–T1).
cards.label: w

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Flexor retinaculum and trapezium.
cards.label: w

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Lateral side of 1st metacarpal.
cards.label: w

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Abductor pollicis brevis muscle
cards.label: x

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Abducts thumb perpendicular to palm and assists opposition.
cards.label: x

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Recurrent branch of median nerve (C8–T1).
cards.label: x

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Flexor retinaculum, scaphoid tubercle and trapezium.
cards.label: x

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Lateral base of proximal phalanx of thumb.
cards.label: x

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Radial artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Terminal branch of brachial artery in the cubital fossa.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Runs down lateral forearm, winds dorsally through the anatomical snuffbox, then enters palm between heads of 1st dorsal interosseous.

cards.question: Branches
cards.answer: In the hand contributes to deep palmar arch, princeps pollicis and radialis indicis arteries.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Major supply to deep palm, thumb and lateral index finger.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Ulnar artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Terminal branch of brachial artery in the cubital fossa.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Descends medial forearm and enters hand superficial to flexor retinaculum through Guyon's canal region.

cards.question: Branches
cards.answer: Forms most of the superficial palmar arch and contributes to the deep palmar arch.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Major arterial supply to superficial palm and medial digits.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superficial palmar arch

cards.question: Formation
cards.answer: Formed mainly by ulnar artery and usually completed by a superficial branch of radial artery.

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Lies superficial to flexor tendons and deep to palmar aponeurosis.

cards.question: Branches
cards.answer: Gives common palmar digital arteries that divide into proper palmar digital arteries.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Supplies palm and digits through digital branches.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Palmar digital arteries

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Arise from superficial palmar arch as common and proper palmar digital arteries.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Run along sides of the digits with digital nerves.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Supply fingers and adjacent palmar tissues.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Dorsal metacarpal arteries

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Arise mainly from the dorsal carpal arch.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Run distally in dorsal intermetacarpal spaces.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Supply dorsum of hand and contribute to dorsal digital arteries.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Ulnar nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: C8–T1, terminal branch of the medial cord of the brachial plexus.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes behind medial epicondyle, descends medial forearm and enters hand superficial to flexor retinaculum through Guyon's canal.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: In the hand supplies hypothenar muscles, interossei, adductor pollicis, deep head of flexor pollicis brevis and medial two lumbricals.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Supplies palmar and dorsal aspects of medial 1½ digits and adjacent hand through palmar, dorsal and digital branches.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Causes weakness of finger abduction/adduction, weak thumb adduction with positive Froment sign, sensory loss over medial 1½ digits and ulnar clawing, especially with distal lesions.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Palmar branch of the ulnar nerve
cards.label: 6a

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Arises from the ulnar nerve in the distal forearm.
cards.label: 6a

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes superficial to flexor retinaculum into the palm.
cards.label: 6a

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Supplies skin over the medial palm/hypothenar region.
cards.label: 6a

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Causes numbness or paraesthesia over the medial palmar hand while sparing the dorsal ulnar hand and intrinsic motor function if the branch alone is affected.
cards.label: 6a

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Dorsal branch of the ulnar nerve
cards.label: 6b

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Arises from the ulnar nerve in the distal forearm proximal to the wrist.
cards.label: 6b

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes dorsally around the ulna to the dorsomedial hand.
cards.label: 6b

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Supplies dorsomedial hand and dorsal aspects of medial 1½ digits, mainly proximal to the nail beds.
cards.label: 6b

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Causes sensory loss or paraesthesia over the dorsomedial hand and dorsal medial 1½ digits without intrinsic hand weakness if the branch alone is affected.
cards.label: 6b

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Radial nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: C5–T1, terminal branch of the posterior cord of the brachial plexus.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Travels in radial groove of humerus, divides near lateral elbow into superficial sensory and deep motor branches; superficial branch reaches dorsolateral hand.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Supplies extensor muscles of arm and forearm through radial/deep branch/posterior interosseous nerve; no intrinsic hand muscles are supplied.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Superficial radial branch supplies dorsolateral hand and proximal dorsal portions of lateral 3½ digits, excluding fingertips.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Proximal radial nerve injury may cause wrist drop with weakness of wrist/finger extension and sensory loss over dorsolateral hand; an isolated superficial branch lesion causes sensory symptoms without motor weakness.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Median nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: C6–T1, formed by lateral and medial roots from lateral and medial cords of the brachial plexus.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Descends forearm and enters the hand through the carpal tunnel beneath the flexor retinaculum.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: In the hand supplies thenar muscles via recurrent branch and lateral two lumbricals.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Supplies palmar surface of lateral 3½ digits and their nail beds/distal dorsal surfaces, plus lateral palm via palmar cutaneous branch.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: At the wrist causes thenar weakness/atrophy with impaired thumb opposition and sensory loss or paraesthesia in lateral 3½ digits; carpal tunnel syndrome typically spares central palm sensation because the palmar cutaneous branch passes superficial to the retinaculum.
